definition.prompt:
Create a square gaming sticker sheet in a clean 3-by-3 grid. Use an original white pixel-art ghost with cobalt-blue headphones, crisp pixel edges and readable pixel lettering.

Use a limited retro palette, a pale cool background and exaggerated gaming reactions. Keep the ghost and headphones consistent, with a design independent of existing game characters.

Exactly nine stickers, read left to right, top to bottom. Give every sticker a distinct expression and pose that clearly matches its caption. Keep the character identity, proportions, outfit and colors consistent across all nine cells. Use generous equal spacing and a simple pale background. Make each silhouette clear, with a white die-cut border. Render each supplied English caption exactly once, verbatim, in large bold lettering inside its own cell, using no more than two lines. The captions, in reading order, are:
GG!; Nice!; My bad.; Lagging.; BRB; One more?; We got this.; So close!; Logging off.

No extra titles, watermarks, overlapping cells or additional text.

review.notes: Inspected nine white pixel ghost cells with cobalt headphones and stepped pixel contours. All nine gaming captions match in reading order, including GG!, BRB, One more? and the single period in Logging off. Distinct win, approval, apology, lag, away, replay, encouragement, near-miss and sleep reactions. Large navy pixel lettering is clear against a pale cool background.
